summary: Short kerb on a quiet residential street, homes on both sides.

best_section.where: South kerb of Cunningham Street, beside the pool house garden

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings on both sides of the street; nearest mapped homes 12-14 m, others 23 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along both kerbs; room for a van between existing cars.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street one block from a busier road; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Residents park along it; overnight not covered by the weekday-daytime sign.

flags: Dwellings 7 m and 9 m away at the two ends
sun_shade: Open sky over the street; houses and trees on the south side shade the afternoon.
